name: s7-s8-8b-diagnostic-correction-1
title: Correction 1 to the 8B diagnostic preregistration: the weights check of the guard, published before any output of the larger model exists
document_status: private; kept outside the public repository
what_failed: the first start stopped in the guard before any model was loaded and before any generation: the cache stores the weights blob as a link again, and resolving the whole chain gave a storage path instead of the content hash
what_changed: only scripts/s7_diag8b.py: the weights check reads the target of the snapshot link, and the guard reads this correction pin, whose inputs replace those of the original pin
what_did_not_change: model, revision, weights hash, configuration, prompt, modules, cases, baseline, needs, decoding, metrics, decision rule and audit rule
note: The commit that adds this file is the public timestamp: no output of the larger model existed when the corrected guard was pinned.
